title: Production Hardening & Deployment Readiness
controls_added: secret-safe env template and ignore rules
request IDs and privacy-conscious JSON logs
browser timeout and retry-safe state behavior
database connect timeout and application name

residual_risks.risk: In-memory rate limiting is process-local and can be bypassed across multiple instances.
residual_risks.owner_action: Deployment owner: add ingress or shared-store rate limiting before a multi-instance pilot.

residual_risks.risk: A shared internal API key is not user-level or role-based authorization.
residual_risks.owner_action: Security/application owner: implement managed service authentication and least privilege before public production.

residual_risks.risk: No complete fresh-database baseline or migration ledger exists in this project directory.
residual_risks.owner_action: Database owner: create a versioned baseline and checksum ledger before a new pilot environment.

residual_risks.risk: Database connections are bounded but not pooled.
residual_risks.owner_action: Deployment/database owner: size and add a pool before sustained pilot traffic.

residual_risks.risk: Backup/restore is documented but was not destructively tested against authoritative data or validated in a disposable database during Phase 9.
residual_risks.owner_action: Database owner: run and record a disposable restore drill before pilot.

residual_risks.risk: Central log aggregation, alerts, WAF, TLS ingress, and provider budget alarms depend on the eventual deployment target.
residual_risks.owner_action: Operations owner: configure these controls when a target is selected.

residual_risks.risk: Student privacy, retention, legal, and incident-response requirements have not been institutionally approved.
residual_risks.owner_action: BCIT privacy/legal/product owners: review and approve the pilot posture.

residual_risks.risk: Browser conversation state is lost on page refresh.
residual_risks.owner_action: Product owner: decide whether privacy-preserving session recovery is needed for pilot UX.

validation.startup_health: live 200; ready 200; docs 404; internal without key 404; internal with key 200
